home.status.label: Project status
home.status.heading: In development
home.status.body: The game connector, control service and desktop interface have implementation work in progress. Automatic driving remains disabled; game-side compatibility and end-to-end control have not been fully verified.
docs.statusFreshnessBody: The desktop interface is in development. If service status stops updating and becomes out of date, it displays a warning. Speed, speed limit and distance change to --; navigation time and driving state show as unavailable.
docs.statusFreshnessNote: An out-of-date status does not by itself mean the service connection has disconnected. A recent status message does not guarantee that every telemetry value is fresh. This behavior has not been verified in the game or in the running desktop interface.
docs.overviewBody: The game connector reads vehicle telemetry through the SCS SDK. The desktop interface and Python service are in development; the control connection sends only neutral or disengaged commands. Automatic driving remains disabled and game-side integration is not fully verified. The desktop can show navigation time remaining as a duration rather than a clock arrival time; this display has not been verified in game.
docs.requirementsBody: The project targets Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit) and Euro Truck Simulator 2. Supported game versions and game-side compatibility have not been fully verified.
docs.installBody: The project includes Windows installer and game connector packaging. Check the project releases for available builds; automatic driving remains disabled.
docs.troubleshootingBody: Further troubleshooting guidance is planned as the project develops.
architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: How the project modules connect and the safeguards being developed.
architecture.heading: Architecture
architecture.intro: This simplified overview describes components in development and their versioned interfaces. Automatic driving remains disabled; game-side compatibility and end-to-end control have not been fully verified.
architecture.diagramDesc: The plugin publishes game telemetry to the Python service, which exchanges status with the desktop interface. The control pipe currently carries only neutral or disengaged commands to the native input module, whose SCS input output remains neutral. The diagram omits frame, perception and physical-input channels.
architecture.flow.one: The game provides vehicle data through the official SCS telemetry SDK to the telemetry plugin.
architecture.flow.two: The telemetry plugin publishes the data to the core through shared memory.
architecture.flow.three: The Python service sends only neutral or disengaged control commands to the native input module through a named pipe.
architecture.flow.four: The input module registers SCS semantic inputs; its output remains neutral while automatic driving is disabled. Game-profile compatibility remains unverified.
architecture.flow.five: The desktop interface exchanges status and requests with the core through a second named pipe.
architecture.module.plugin.name: Telemetry plugin
architecture.module.plugin.role: Loads into the game as an SCS SDK plugin and publishes vehicle data to shared memory.
architecture.module.input.name: Input module
architecture.module.input.role: Runs in the game plugin and registers SCS semantic inputs. Output remains neutral; game-profile compatibility is unverified.
architecture.module.core.name: Core
architecture.module.core.role: Processes telemetry and perception and reports status. Control candidates are not forwarded; it does not access game memory directly.
architecture.module.ui.name: Desktop interface
architecture.module.ui.role: Displays settings, status and current-session activity, and provides capture and input observations. It can show navigation time remaining; missing or invalid values or outdated telemetry are shown as unavailable, though display updates may be delayed. A recent telemetry update does not prove the navigation value itself was refreshed. Engagement remains disabled.
architecture.safetyIntro: Safety mechanisms are under development. Physical-input coverage, road detection and game integration are not fully validated; automatic driving remains disabled.
architecture.safety.one: Manual input is intended to take priority. Physical-device coverage has not been validated, so the monitor cannot authorize engagement.
architecture.safety.two: The prototype bounds control candidates; the native input core independently enforces range and rate limits.
architecture.safety.three: If fresh, valid commands stop arriving within a short time limit, the input module sets all outputs to zero and disengages.
architecture.safety.four: After a disconnect, timeout or manual override, the intended design requires a fresh request before assistance resumes. Automatic driving remains disabled.
architecture.safety.five: The desktop interface only requests actions and shows status. It never runs the control loop.
